ai.title: Fix doc heading anchors and copy-link behavior
ai.summary: Refactored MDX heading components in `web/src/components/docs/mdx/mdx-components.tsx` to generate hierarchical IDs (e.g., `#h2-title` for h2+) and fixed anchor link generation for all subsections. Logic moved from `web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx` to a shared `Mdx` component, ensuring consistent copy-link buttons and scroll behavior across h1-h4. Internal docs rendering only.

eli5.text: You can now copy a direct link to any heading in the internal documentation and it will reliably scroll to that section. Previously, only the top-level headings got stable links, while links to subsections behaved inconsistently or failed to highlight correctly. The system now generates hierarchical IDs for all headings (for example, #overview for the main title and #h2-getting-started for subheadings), and the copy-link button next to each heading produces a URL that preserves its exact place in the document. This ensures that shared documentation links land readers at the precise subsection they need, without ambiguity or incorrect scrolling.
